@echo off
echo Restoring Laptop Sleep States and Battery Management...
bcdedit /set disabledynamictick no >nul 2>&1
Reg.exe add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power" /v "CsEnabled" /t REG_DWORD /d "1" /f >nul 2>&1
Reg.exe delete "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power" /v "PlatformAoAcOverride" /f >nul 2>&1
Reg.exe add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Processor" /v "Cstates" /t REG_DWORD /d "1" /f >nul 2>&1
Reg.exe add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Processor" /v "AllowPepPerfStates" /t REG_DWORD /d "1" /f >nul 2>&1
Reg.exe delete "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\USB" /v "DisableSelectiveSuspend" /f >nul 2>&1
powercfg /restoredefaultschemes >nul 2>&1
echo Laptop power management restored. Restart your PC.
pause
